async function run(items, read) {
 let value = null;
 for (const item of items) {
  ({value} = item);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  value ??= await read(item);
 }
 for (const item of items) {
  [key, value] = item;
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  if (value == null) value = await read(key);
 }
}
async function once(items, read) {
 let value = null;
 for (const item of items) {
  ({key} = item);
  value ??= await read();
 }
}
